Austin's efforts to obtain answers about his brother's medical care
novel_facts: A Monday procession transported Austin from the Medical Examiner's Office in Fort Pierce to Stone Brothers Funeral Home.
The incoming report gives a 7:25 a.m. emergency response time for a reported cardiac arrest and says Austin was transported to HCA Florida Lawnwood Hospital.
Friends Bernard Taylor and Bonnie Hill share memories and describe support for Austin's mother.
Additional background describes Austin's petition to repeal Florida's medical-malpractice wrongful-death restrictions.
